**Finding resubmitted: compliant (AUDIT) — no redline, no comment.**

- **Position held, rationale sharpened.** The verifier's substantive review agreed on every point: § 11.3/p0132 is AUP/content-warranty enforcement, not usage or fee verification; p0137 adds only a best-efforts pre-removal notice; neither gives IBM access to our systems or records to measure usage or charges, so the AUDIT parameters do not attach.
- **Compliant, not "missing" or deviation.** The Agreement contains no audit right binding Customer at all (no hits for audit/inspect/verify/records/monitor; §§ 11.5 and 13.2 add nothing). That is better than the preferred position and favours Bluefly, so the playbook's direction rule bars flagging it.
- **Failed deterministic check addressed in the rationale.** "Audit frequency limited" cannot match because there is no audit clause to carry a frequency cap; the regex miss is noise, not an unmet position.
- **File notes only:** no investigator confidentiality, no express no-system-access limit, best-efforts notice — available as narrow asks if § 11.3 is reopened. Suspension/termination remedies in § 11.3(a)–(d) are deferred to those rules.
